transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Nisha. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Nisha, I am beyond frustrated. My phone has been dropping calls every five minutes and I can't get any work done. This is ridiculous!
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you're experiencing these connectivity issues, Sneha. I can certainly understand how frustrating it is when your service disrupts your work.
Customer: It's just not acceptable. If this isn't fixed right now, I'm going to cancel my contract and switch to another provider immediately.
Agent: I want to make sure we get this sorted for you. Before we look into the account details, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: Fine. My account number is 36763445 and my name is Sneha Gupta.
Agent: Thank you, Sneha. I've accessed your account. I see you're using the phone number 96499 29199. Is that correct?
Customer: Yes, that's the one.
Agent: I've run a quick diagnostic on the line and it looks like there might be a hardware fault with your device. I'd like to get this resolved for you as quickly as possible.
Customer: So what does that mean? Do I just have to live with a broken phone?
Agent: Not at all. I am going to book a device check with our technical team to pinpoint the exact issue and see if it needs a replacement.
Customer: Oh, thank goodness. I was worried I'd have to spend hours trying to fix it myself. I appreciate you taking care of this.
Agent: You're very welcome. Since this requires a specialist's review, I am escalating this ticket to our hardware support team who will contact you within 24 hours to confirm the appointment.
Customer: That sounds perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Nisha.
Agent: It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? To recap, I've booked the device check and escalated your case to the hardware team. Goodbye!
